input_text: A critical vulnerability affecting software in your stack is actively being exploited and includes matching IOCs from your logs.
A medium-severity vulnerability targets software your organization uses but shows no signs of active exploitation.
A high-severity threat is widely exploited but does not affect any technologies in your environment.
A low-severity alert includes an IP address that appears in your network logs but has no software match.
An older high-severity vulnerability affects your systems but has not been exploited in recent years.
